answer: Each agent must lock stake behind a unique, slowly earned credential, then pay a fee whenever it makes a claim that others can challenge. A quorum of randomly selected, established agents checks the evidence; if a claim is disproved, the stake is slashed and the credential loses standing. A falcon account cannot simply mirror itself into a flock: every new identity needs fresh capital and time, while coordinated lies risk forfeiting that capital. Yarrow rewards can fund honest checks, but do not make Sybils free.
